description:
Unleash powerful cleaning wherever you go with this Cordless Electric Pressure Washer Gun Kit. No more tangles, no more outlets—just grab the sleek, lightweight washer and start blasting away dirt, grime, and mud from your car, bike, patio, or outdoor furniture. Featuring two 21 V lithium‑ion batteries, you get extended runtime for thorough cleaning without interruption. The ceramic‑piston pump delivers up to 40 bar (580 PSI) of water pressure, yet it’s gentle enough for delicate surfaces.

Easily switch between 0°, 15°, and 25° spray tips for pinpoint precision or wide‑area coverage, and use the included foam lance to apply thick suds for deep‑down cleaning. A generous 8 m high‑pressure hose gives you full reach around vehicles and garden areas, and everything packs neatly into the rugged carry case—ideal for storage or transport. With quick‑connect fittings and tool‑free assembly, this portable power washer turns any fresh‑water source into a high‑performance cleaning station in seconds.

features: 100% Cordless Convenience Dual 21 V/4 Ah batteries deliver long runtimes—no cords or generators required.
High‑Pressure Pump Ceramic‑piston pump generates up to 40 bar (580 PSI) for fast dirt removal.
Versatile Nozzle Set Includes 0°, 15°, 25° quick‑connect tips plus a foam lance for customizable spray patterns.
Long‑Reach Hose 8 m reinforced high‑pressure hose for full coverage around vehicles and outdoor areas.
Portable Carry Case Rugged hard-shell case keeps all components organized and protected.
Tool‑Free Assembly Quick‑connect fittings for no‑hassle setup—go from box to cleaning in under 60 seconds.
Lightweight & Ergonomic Weighing just 3.1 kg (with battery), it’s easy on your arms even during extended use.
Fresh‑Water Use Connects to any standard garden tap or bucket—perfect for car washes, patios, bikes, boats, and more.
